comment: Stories whose play function is already broken, found the first time the catalog pass rendered every story. Each selector went stale during the Astryx migration and nothing executed it. The catalog pass fails on any story NOT listed here, and also fails when a listed story starts passing — so this list is a to-do, not a permanent exemption. Fixing them needs each component's current DOM, which is a separate change from wiring the guard up.

knownBroken.product-ask-user-question--other-answer-: getByRole('textbox', { name: '其他答案' }) — user-question-prompt.tsx no longer exposes that accessible name
